name: Ashley Dantes
source:
Your twin-sister, sharing in your [url=https://vndb.org/c148151]mother[/url]'s quick temper, something you both seemed to get. The two of you used to be inseparable, but for some reason the fighting between the two of you seemed to become more and more frequent, until it got to the point of a total breakdown of communication. Still if anyone can repair the relationship, it's [url=https://vndb.org/c148150]you[/url]

[In game description]
